annotations.annotation_text: Section title marking the heist crew's procurement phase across the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis (BAMA) and Istanbul to assemble military icebreakers, constructs, and holographic hardware.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 46.

annotations.target_phrase: Home was BAMA, the Sprawl, the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis
annotations.annotation_text: The Sprawl: the continuous megalopolis running along the northeastern seaboard of the United States, enclosed in geodesic domes with synthetic weather and neon-choked transit subways.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 46.
